name: Inraku no Majo Hime
source:
Erika is a guardian of a ruin.
However, the seal was suddenly broken and monsters ran away.
She follows after them to confine them again...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ055226.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
埃里卡是废墟的守护者。
然而，封印突然被打破，怪物纷纷逃跑。
她跟在他们身后，再次将他们禁锢起来……
